title: A compact K ⊆ O has an open neighbourhood V ⊆ O of finite measure with μ(V ∖ K) < ε
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let O ⊆ ℝ^N (= EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) be open, let K ⊆ O be compact, and let μ be a measure on the Borel σ-algebra of ℝ^N with μ(L) < ∞ for every compact L ⊆ O. Then for every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is an open set V ⊆ ℝ^N with K ⊆ V ⊆ O, μ(V) < ∞ and μ(V ∖ K) < ε.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (O K : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)), IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → (∀ L : Set (Rn N), IsCompact L → L ⊆ O → μ L < ∞) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ V : Set (Rn N), IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ V ⊆ O ∧ μ V < ∞ ∧ μ (V \ K) < ε
